newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells out 16 bln levs 3-, 6-mth T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells out 16 bln levs 3-, 6-mth T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance ministry issues of three- and six-month discount T-bills were sold out at Monday's auctions, yielding 3.80 and 6.79 percent to maturity, respectively, central bank figures showed.
The issues were offered with a par value of eight billion
levs each and no minimum acceptable prices set in advance.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Par value 8,000 million levs 8,000 million levs
Bids received 41,588.4 million levs 84,070.5 million levs
Average price of bids 95.14 pct 90.85 pct
Bids approved 8,000 million levs 8,000 million levs
Average yield to maturity 3.80 pct 6.79 pct
